svg.title: ArchFlow bounded input and context flow
svg.desc: Six bounded input classes pass through authority, document identity, exact-manifest lexical retrieval, exact-read validation, and a source-visible context capsule.
svg.text: Input flow — bounded context selection without losing provenance
Stable rules are reused; task evidence comes only from the exact manifest; source paths and exact reads remain mandatory for action.

text.tspan: bind goal, role, risk, and stop.
Retrieval does not “perceive the whole project” by itself.
Usable context = stable rules + exact-manifest retrieval + source paths + exact reads + recorded gaps.
If source identity, freshness, or manifest admission fails,
return a GAP; never expand the corpus automatically.
